title: If AI Writes the Code and AI Reviews the Code, What Exactly Is the Developer Verifying?
why_read: A relevant and timely reflection on what human code review actually needs to verify when both code generation and code review are increasingly automated by AI.
analysis: The piece raises a genuinely important question as AI tools handle more of the software development pipeline: what is left for a human reviewer to meaningfully check when AI writes, tests, and reviews the same code? It cites a real data point that GitHub Copilot's review feature now handles over one in five code reviews on GitHub, which is a striking figure about how far AI has penetrated real workflows. The core argument, that AI reviewing AI-generated code risks encoding the same blind spots or wrong assumptions rather than catching them, is a solid and underappreciated point for engineering teams adopting these tools. It's more thoughtful than typical AI-hype content, focusing on a concrete failure mode (shared assumptions) rather than vague warnings.
